Subject: Summary of the client meeting

Dear John,

I wanted to send you a quick summary of our meeting on May 5, 2024. Below are the key points and action items:

• Discussed your requirements for the new project
• Agreed on project timeline and key milestones
• Reviewed initial design concepts and gathered your feedback

Action items:
• Emma to update project plan based on your feedback
• David to coordinate with development team
• Next meeting scheduled for June 1, 2024

Please let me know if you have any questions or need further clarification on any of these points.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
